title: Areeza e darvaish
body:
Areeza e darvaish
<<MINI>>
Hussain...
Sooz e dilam, ka'ba e mann, karbobalai
<<DIVIDER>>
na mikhwaham, jahanam
<<MINI>>
Hussain, hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Na mikhwaham..(3)
<<MINI>>
sada bezan... sada bezann
na mikhwaham ee jahaan sada bezan
sada bezan... sada bezann
na mikhwaham ee jahaan sada bezan
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil ke arbab mere
kab mujhe izn mile
jald bulwa le mujhe
<<MINI>>
sada bezan... sada bezann
na mikhwaham ee jahaan sada bezan

Ya hussain....
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye mere dard ke mehram maula
door hai tujhse ye beemar tera..(2)
dil ye seene me na reh payega
jald bulwa le mujhe karbobala
<<MINI>>
sada bezan... sada bezann
na mikhwaham ee jahaan sada bezan

Allah humma arzuqna ziyaratal hussain

Arbaeen ho ke wo ho ashura
ek sailaab azadaro ka
shukr ka karta hai tujhko sajda
<<MINI>>
Hussain, hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye khuda, Ma ke dil na darum magar ma ke dil na darum aye khuda
un croro mein bus ek mai hi nahi..(2)
soch kar phat-ta hai dil ye mera

yehi nauha hi areeza hai mera
ab to darvaish ko didaar mile
